name: sony.com.co
body: Every page has a title, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But plain http serves the site without redirecting.
lesson: Redirect every http request to https with one permanent 301, then add HSTS.
summary: The site's bot protection refused the plain request and headless Chrome while it carried the review tag; the page was analyzed in headless Chrome without the tag. Partial analysis: 93 of 93 linked pages answered with a bot check or a block, so the scores rest mostly on the start page. www.sony.com.co scores 51 out of 100 (F). 12 checks fail now, 25 are at risk, and 23 pass. Fix first: tracking…

fix.title: Tracking starts before the visitor chooses
fix.evidence: OneTrust was showing. Before any choice, Chromium from an EU address (Belgium) saw Adobe Analytics (5 requests), and cookies demdex on demdex.net, YSC on youtube.com, dextp on demdex.net, dpm on dpm.demdex.net, AMCV_7286403D53B6AA9A0A490D4C%40AdobeOrg, s_cc.
fix.fix: Hold every tag until consent, or set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads. Block third-party embeds until the visitor agrees.

fix.title: Elements must only use supported ARIA attributes
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 5 elements on /, for example span[data-actionable-item-value="Televisiones y Teatro en Casa"] and span[data-actionable-item-value="Audio"]. Impact: critical.

fix.title: Plain http serves the site without redirecting
fix.evidence: http:// answered 403. Visitors who type the address stay unencrypted.
fix.fix: Redirect every http request to https with a 301, then add HSTS.

fix.title: Scripts fingerprint the browser before the visitor chooses
fix.evidence: OneTrust was showing. Before any choice, www.sony.com.co drew hidden text on a canvas and read it back, read the graphics card name, and rendered a silent audio tone. Read together, these give the browser an ID that survives clearing cookies.
fix.fix: Find the tag behind each host and hold it until consent, like a tracking cookie. If it is fraud or bot protection, name it in the privacy notice.

fix.title: Fingerprinting continues after Reject
fix.evidence: After pressing "Rechazarlas todas" and reloading, www.sony.com.co drew hidden text on a canvas and read it back, read the graphics card name, and rendered a silent audio tone.
fix.fix: Block the fingerprinting tag when the visitor refuses, or remove it.

fix.title: 1 form control has no label
fix.evidence: On /. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

works.title: AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Front-end libraries have no known flaw
The largest element paints in 1.7 s
Every page has a meta description
Share cards have a title, description, image, and URL
